short_term_messages.content: It's a good idea to check with Safeway directly or visit their website for the most current information on the food safety inspection, as well as to confirm the store's hours of operation during the inspection period.
The store has reported a possible mislabeling of products containing nuts

If you have purchased products from the Safeway in Berryessa that contain nuts and have concerns about mislabeling, it's best to contact Safeway directly or check their website for more information. You may also want to consider reaching out to the local health department or a consumer protection agency for guidance and support.
All products possibly containing the ingredients have currently been removed from store shelves

Safeway in Berryessa has removed all products possibly containing nuts from store shelves following a reported mislabeling issue, and customers are advised to contact the store directly for more information and guidance.
Any customers who believe they may have purchased one of the recalled products may contact the store directly by calling them
If you suspect you may have purchased a product containing nuts from Safeway in Berryessa, please contact the store directly to report your concern and receive guidance on next steps.
The store manager is currently keeping track of the situation to keep everyone informed and updated
Safeway in Berryessa is taking steps to address the reported mislabeling of products containing nuts, and customers are advised to contact the store directly for updates and guidance on next steps.
The majority of the affected products are from the supplier HealthySnacks inc.
Customers who may have purchased products from HealthySnacks Inc. that were sold at Safeway in Berryessa are advised to contact the store directly for guidance and support.
What store is affected by the recall and what products are affected?
Safeway in Berryessa is recalling products containing nuts due to possible mislabeling, with HealthySnacks Inc. being the affected supplier.
What was the supplier where the recalled items came from, and what should customers do if they purchased one?
Contact Safeway directly for guidance and support if you suspect you may have purchased a product containing nuts from HealthySnacks Inc.
Results of the safety inspection are expected to be released within a week after conducted.
